ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to College of Business majors. A limited number of seats will be available for Finance and BADM majors. On Nov. 25 at 11 a.m. any remaining seats will open to College of Business students. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken.
